LanguageData.MM_GuardianFieldDesc: Spend 10 seeds to immediately create an 8-cell-radius shield for 30 seconds. Each hostile projectile touching it has a 50% chance to return along its original path; otherwise it passes through. Fields from different Guardians roll independently and can overlap.
LanguageData.MM_AutonomyDesc: Bind a mechanitor to operate without a pilot, using {0} bandwidth. Joins the mechanitor control group; draft to move and attack within command range. Still requires light.
LanguageData.MM_AutonomyDisconnectDesc: Stop autonomous operation and release bandwidth. You can bind another mechanitor or board a pilot.
LanguageData.MM_AutonomyBandwidth: The mechanitor has insufficient available bandwidth.
